label: class_a_08_ecology_01
text: Hello hello, everyone. Today is our final exam.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_08_ecology_02
text: It will cover everything I’ve taught you so far! But\nI’m sure you all will do just fine.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_08_ecology_03
text: Take your time, and contemplate each question\ncarefully.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_08_question_01
text:
1. How many of the following four methods
    make it easier to catch a Pokémon?

    ・Inflicting paralysis   ・Using a Poké Toy
    ・Feeding it a Berry   ・Surprising it from behind

label: class_a_08_ansewer_01a
text: One

label: class_a_08_ansewer_01b
text: Two

label: class_a_08_ansewer_01c
text: Three

label: class_a_08_ansewer_01d
text: Four

label: class_a_08_question_02
text: 2. True or false? You can get new Pokémon\n    only by catching them yourself or trading\n    with other Trainers.

label: class_a_08_ansewer_02a
text: True

label: class_a_08_ansewer_02b
text: False

label: class_a_08_question_03
text:
3. If a Pokémon is holding an Everstone, will
    using an item that induces Evolution, such as
    a Fire Stone, cause it to evolve?

A) Yes, it will
B) No, it won’t

label: class_a_08_ansewer_03a
text: A) Yes, it will

label: class_a_08_ansewer_03b
text: B) No, it won’t

label: class_a_08_question_04
text:
4. What is the probability of running into a
    Shiny Pokémon?

A) 1 in 2,000
B) 1 in 4,000
C) 1 in 6,000

label: class_a_08_question_05
text: 5. True or false? The Pokémon known as Oricorio\n    has three forms.

label: class_a_08_ansewer_05a
text: True

label: class_a_08_ansewer_05b
text: False

label: class_a_08_question_06
text:
—This question won’t affect your grade!—

Do you have anything you would like to say
about my class? I’m still getting used to this
teaching thing, but I sure had fun as your teacher!

label: class_a_08_ansewer_06a
text: It was fun!

label: class_a_08_ansewer_06b
text: Thank you for being our teacher!

label: class_a_08_ansewer_06c
text: Keep teaching! You can do it!

label: class_a_08_ecology_04
text: OK! Time’s up whether you like it or not! I hope\neveryone enjoyed tackling those questions![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_08_ecology_05
text: Hehe... I snuck in a little bonus question there\nright at the end again. Shhh, our little secret—\r\ndon’t tell the director![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_08_ecology_06
text: I’ll grade these right away. I hope you’re all\nlooking forward to seeing how you did![VAR 0x0114(002A)]
